meta.project: Integrated ESG-ABSA Intelligence Framework (v-1 to v3)
meta.description: Comprehensive reference mapping of the five-layer research plan to technical contributions and literature evidence.

research_questions: RQ1.1: How can Transformer-based architectures be optimized for bilingual ESG ABSA?
RQ1.3: How can regional calibration and ESG lexicons mitigate bias?

literature_references.title: CMHG: A Dataset and Benchmark for Headline Generation of Minority Languages in China
literature_references.relevance: Supports C1 and C9 by providing a scalable benchmark for minority and low-resource languages, validating the semantic infrastructure needed for bilingual systems.

literature_references.title: Multi-LMentry: Can Multilingual LLMs Solve Elementary Tasks Across Languages?
literature_references.relevance: Directly addresses RQ1.1 and C3 by exposing failure modes in core model abilities across nine languages, justifying the need for optimized cross-lingual transfer.

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)
research_questions: RQ2.1: To what extent does few-shot learning improve ESG granularity?
RQ2.2: How can long-context mechanisms enhance scalability?
RQ2.4: How can multi-LLM fusion reduce hallucination?

literature_references.title: DrDiff: Dynamic Routing Diffusion with Hierarchical Attention for Breaking the Efficiency-Quality Trade-off
literature_references.relevance: Validates C13 and RQ2.2 through the use of dynamic expert scheduling and hierarchical attention to manage long-text scalability challenges.

literature_references.title: HMoE: Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts for Language Modeling
literature_references.relevance: Supports C10 and RQ2.4 by utilizing experts with diverse capacities to handle varying input complexity, thereby reducing parameter imbalance and single-model bias.

research_questions: RQ3.1: How can symbolic reasoning be integrated using ESG ontologies?
RQ3.2: How can transparent outputs be ensured via reasoning graphs?
RQ3.3: How can implicit ESG claims be identified?

literature_references.title: LogicTree: Structured Proof Exploration for Coherent and Rigorous Logical Reasoning with Large Language Models
literature_references.relevance: Operationalizes C7 and RQ3.2 by employing algorithm-guided search to automate structured proof exploration and ensure logical transparency.

literature_references.title: Context-Aware Hierarchical Taxonomy Generation for Scientific Papers via LLM-Guided Multi-Aspect Clustering
literature_references.relevance: Supports C15 and RQ3.1 by integrating aspect-specific summaries with dynamic clustering to form coherent semantic hierarchies, enforcing ontology-aligned correctness.

research_questions: RQ4.1: How can XAI improve stakeholder trust in ESG outputs?
RQ4.2: How can cross-model consistency be measured?
RQ4.5: Can tone–outcome mismatch reliably indicate greenwashing?

literature_references.title: Debate-to-Detect: Reformulating Misinformation Detection as a Real-World Debate with Large Language Models
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports C11 and RQ4.5 by utilizing multi-agent adversarial debates to evaluate factual reliability and reasoning quality in deceptive narratives.

literature_references.title: A Multi-Agent Framework with Automated Decision Rule Optimization for Cross-Domain Misinformation Detection
literature_references.relevance: Addresses RQ4.2 by proposing a question-reflection mechanism among agents to improve detection quality across differing domains.

research_questions: RQ5.1: How can transparent and auditable outputs be ensured?
RQ5.2: How can reasoning quality and consistency be operationalized at scale?

literature_references.title: A Position Paper on the Automatic Generation of Machine Learning Leaderboards
literature_references.relevance: Provides the methodological basis for the reproducible benchmarking required in C5 and RQ5.2, advocating for standardised conceptual frameworks.

literature_references.title: PPTAgent: Generating and Evaluating Presentations Beyond Text-to-Slides
literature_references.relevance: Supports C12 and RQ5.1 by operationalizing structural coherence and visual appeal in output artifacts, ensuring usability in real-world environments.
